title: Grade 5 French — Mon, May 25
description: Greetings & Introductions (Salutations et Présentations) — Day 1 of 5
subject: french

questions.question: How do you say 'Good morning' in French?
questions.explanation: 'Bonjour' means 'Good morning' or 'Hello' (used during the day). 'Bonsoir' is 'Good evening'.

questions.question: How do you say 'My name is Ana' in French?
questions.explanation: 'Je m'appelle Ana' = 'My name is Ana'. 'Je m'appelle' literally means 'I call myself'.

questions.question: What does 'Comment t'appelles-tu?' mean?
questions.explanation: 'Comment t'appelles-tu?' = 'What is your name?' (informal). Formal version: 'Comment vous appelez-vous?'

questions.question: How do you say 'I am 10 years old' in French?
questions.explanation: In French, use 'avoir' (to have) for age: 'J'ai dix ans' = 'I have ten years' = 'I am ten years old'.

questions.question: What does 'Au revoir' mean?
questions.explanation: 'Au revoir' = 'Goodbye'. It literally means 'Until we see each other again'.

questions.question: 'Comment ça va?' is best translated as:
questions.explanation: 'Comment ça va?' = 'How are you?' (informal). You can answer: 'Ça va bien' (I'm fine).

questions.question: What is the French for 'Thank you'?
How do you say 'I am from India' in French?
questions.explanation: 'Je viens d'Inde' = 'I come from India'. 'Venir de' is used to express where you are from.

questions.question: What does 'Enchanté(e)' mean?
questions.explanation: 'Enchanté' (for males) / 'Enchantée' (for females) = 'Nice to meet you' / 'Pleased to meet you'.

questions.question: 'S'il te plaît' vs 'S'il vous plaît' — what is the difference?
options: S'il te plaît is formal, S'il vous plaît is informal
S'il te plaît is informal (to a friend), S'il vous plaît is formal (to an adult/stranger)
questions.explanation: 'S'il te plaît' is informal 'please' (used with friends, family). 'S'il vous plaît' is formal 'please' (adults, strangers).

questions.question: How do you say 'Good night' in French?
questions.explanation: 'Bonne nuit' = 'Good night' (said when going to bed). 'Bonsoir' = 'Good evening' (greeting in the evening).

questions.question: What is the French word for 'friend'?
How do you ask 'Where do you live?' in French?
questions.explanation: 'Où tu habites?' = 'Where do you live?' (informal). 'Habiter' means 'to live/reside'.

questions.question: Which greeting would you use at 8 PM?
questions.explanation: 'Bonsoir' is used as an evening greeting (from about 6 PM onwards). 'Bonjour' is for daytime.
